lucky_wheel.lead_sub: Sign up, Spin to win, and unlock your exclusive 24-hour head start on Black Friday.
lucky_wheel.heading: Lucky Wheel — 100% Win Rate!
lucky_wheel.step_1: Click the “Play” button on the wheel.
lucky_wheel.step_2: Enter your email to unlock your spin.
lucky_wheel.step_3: Spin the wheel to reveal your prizes.
lucky_wheel.step_4: Discounts start November 18 and can be combined with Black Friday deals!
lucky_wheel.modal_title: One Spin Per Person · Everyone Wins
lucky_wheel.modal_sub: Sign up and spin to get your early-access link by email on November 18, and shop Black Friday deals 24 hours early.

lucky_wheel.term_1_body: Every eligible participant will win a reward from the Lucky Wheel. Rewards are assigned randomly.
lucky_wheel.term_2_body: Some rewards may require a minimum order value. Please check the conditions shown with your reward before placing your order.
lucky_wheel.term_3_body: Each eligible customer may spin the wheel once during the promotion period. One reward is available per email address.
lucky_wheel.term_4_body: All Lucky Wheel rewards are valid for redemption during the Black Friday sale starting November 19, 2026. Each reward is subject to its specific terms and cannot be combined with other spin rewards unless otherwise stated.
lucky_wheel.term_5_body: If a return, cancellation, or order adjustment causes the order to fall below the required minimum spend, the reward may no longer apply. Any refund adjustment will be handled in accordance with the applicable refund policy.
lucky_wheel.term_6_body: PGYTECH reserves the right to amend or end this promotion where necessary due to misuse, technical problems, or other exceptional circumstances. All participants are subject to PGYTECH’s applicable promotional terms and conditions.
